verse.verse_1: Ashe, ba ka ga yadda Ubangijinka Ya aikata ga mutanen giwa ba?
verse.verse_2: Ashe, bai sanya kaidinsu a cikin ɓata ba?
verse.verse_3: Kuma Ya sako, a kansu, wasu tsuntsãye, jama'a-jama'a.
verse.verse_4: Suna jifar su da wasu duwatsu na yumɓun wuta.
verse.verse_5: Sa'an nan Ya sanya su kamar karmami wanda aka cinye?
